x: Milk (deciduous) teeth begin to fall at about 6 years, and the incisors are shed by about 6-8 years, so most keys give 6-8. Shedding of canines and molars continues until about 12, which is why 10-12 is only the end of the process.
dispute: Most books and keys: between 6 and 8 years. Strictly: shedding starts at about 6 and is complete by about 12 (incisors 6-8, canines and molars 9-12) (AAP healthychildren.org; Wikipedia 'Deciduous teeth').
